item.title: Refactor orders crate order status from String to OrderStatus enum
item.brief:
Operator request (authenticated local socket): The `orders` crate stores an order's status as a `String` and compares string literals all over the code. Refactor it to a proper type.

- Add `src/status.rs` with `pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }` deriving at least `Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash`.
- `OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str` returns the lowercase names ("pending", "paid", "shipped", "cancelled"); `Display` prints the same.
- `FromStr` for `OrderStatus` with `type Err = ParseStatusError`, a public error type that implements `std::error::Error` and whose message names the rejected input.
- `OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool` encodes the lifecycle: pending -> paid, pending -> cancelled, paid -> shipped, paid -> cancelled; nothing else.
- `Order::status` becomes an `OrderStatus`; re-export `OrderStatus` and `ParseStatusError` from the crate root; use the enum everywhere, so the status string literals appear only in `src/status.rs`.

Observable behaviour (errors, report output and ordering, parsing) must stay exactly the same, and `cargo test` must pass. Commit your work.

Acceptance: `cargo test` passes; status string literals occur only in src/status.rs; report output and parse errors are unchanged versus the baseline; work is committed on the item's branch (local ship, no push). Before editing, record the current report output and parse-error messages so they can be compared after the change.

pr.body:
Approach: new src/status.rs holds OrderStatus (Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled), as_str, Display, FromStr with public ParseStatusError (message: unknown status "<input>"), can_transition_to (pending->paid, pending->cancelled, paid->shipped, paid->cancelled). Order::status, billing::pay, shipping::ship, Order::cancel, Order::is_open, billing::outstanding_cents, shipping::ready_to_ship, report::to_line/from_line/status_counts use the enum. status_counts now returns Vec<(OrderStatus, usize)>, sorted by as_str so output order matches the old BTreeMap ordering. from_line keeps its error text via ParseStatusError Display.

Checks: cargo fmt --check clean; cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean; cargo test: 3 unit (status module) and 3 integration tests pass. Behaviour check: a temporary probe that printed transitions, errors, counts, lists and parse results gave byte-identical output before and after (probe removed, not committed).

Breaking public API: Order.status is OrderStatus instead of String; status_counts returns OrderStatus instead of String. Derived Debug of Order prints `Pending` instead of `"pending"`.

Not pushed. Nothing left running.
pr.summary: Made order status a typed enum. Now the lifecycle rules and names live in one place (src/status.rs). Before: Order.status was a String compared to literals in four modules. Now: OrderStatus with can_transition_to, FromStr and Display; observable messages and report ordering unchanged.
